questions.question: Why did King Artaxerxes of Persia grant the scribe Ezra all of his requests?

answers.text: The hand of the LORD was upon him
The queen of Persia spoke for him
The elders of Judah stood with him

questions.question: When Ezra went up from Babylon to Jerusalem, he made the trip completely alone. True or false?
Ezra set his heart to study and practice the Law of the LORD. What else did he set his heart to do?
King Artaxerxes gave Ezra silver and gold for God's house in Jerusalem. What did he tell Ezra to buy with it?

answers.text: Animals to offer on the altar
Stone and timber for the walls
